name: arletex-root
description: Local-first desktop environment and host infrastructure for Arle, a persistent artificial individual.

scripts.build:native: cmake -B native/build -S native -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build native/build -j4 && mkdir -p apps/desktop/src/backend/native && cp native/build/reflex_engine apps/desktop/src/backend/native/reflex_engine
scripts.build: pnpm run build:native && pnpm --filter "@arletex/*" run build
scripts.clean: pnpm -r --parallel exec rimraf dist out node_modules
